title: Grateful Dead Live at SANTA CLARA FAIRGROUNDS on 1968-05-18
lineage: JORMA'S AUD MASTER > 3RD GEN CASSETTE > CD > SOUNDFORGE EXTRACTION > COOL EDIT > CD WAVE EDITOR
source: JORMA'S AUD MASTER > 3RD GEN CASSETTE > CD

ai_review.summary: High‑voltage 1968 performance with Jerry’s blazing Alligator jam, captured on a decent audience tape despite muffled Pigpen vocals.
ai_review.review: The show is described as wild, hairy and full of electricity – especially Jerry Garcia’s post‑drums Alligator/‘Mountain Jam’ that leaves the crowd buzzing. Recording quality is only fair for its era; the vocal from Pigpen is low and the tape is a bit ragged, but the raw energy shines through.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews consistently praise the high‑energy performance (70% weight) and note only modest recording flaws (30% weight), resulting in an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reasonable for 1968 but vocals (Pigpen) are low, tape is ragged at points and a bit muffled; some feedback at the end adds character.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set builds with high voltage throughout, culminating in a feedback‑laden ending that tapers off on a cymbal.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly called pure electricity, on fire, and delivering a masterful Alligator/Mountain Jam after the drums.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mentioned as the launch point for the post‑drums jam and ending with a single cymbal tap.
